description: This wheat-model benchmark assembles five field experiments covering carbon dioxide, nitrogen, water deficit and temperature treatments in the United States, Netherlands, New Zealand, Australia and Mexico. The research partners provide 65 treatments and more than 1,000 observations, with crop development, yields, weather, soil and cultivar information. Harvard Dataverse’s own API identifies 28 text files under CC0 for free reuse. The data can calibrate crop and irrigation-demand simulations across contrasting conditions. Experimental coverage is limited to the tested cultivars, sites and treatment ranges, and differences among protocols require care before pooling observations. Treatment definitions must remain linked to their respective experiment. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Field experimental data for crop modeling of wheat growth response to nitrogen fertilizer, elevated CO2, water stress, and high temperature
notes: G4-0204; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
